{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black warhammer |image = [[File:Black warhammer.png]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = I don't think it's intended for joinery. |value = 980 |weight = 1.814 |exchange = Yes |id = 1341 }} [[File:Black warhammer detail.png|left|120px]] The '''black warhammer''' is a [[warhammer]] stronger than the [[steel warhammer]]. [[Members]] can purchase it from [[Vigr's Warhammers]] in [[Keldagrim]] and [[Skulgrimen's Battle Gear]] in [[Rellekka]]. The black warhammer requires 10 [[Strength]] to wield. The black warhammer can be used as a substitute for a regular [[hammer]] when banging the big door at the entrance of [[Bandos' Stronghold]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black warhammer cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = -4 |aslash = -4 |acrush = 22 |amagic = -4 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 22 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 6 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Blunt |image = [[File:Black warhammer equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Black warhammer equipped female.png|150px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Blunt|speed=6|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black warhammer}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black warhammer}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 July 2021 |update = Small Changes & Tweaks |poll = |change = The weapon's position on female players has been adjusted so that they appear to be equipped properly. }} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = * Black warhammers now require level 10 Strength to wield instead of level 10 Attack. * The black warhammer's strength bonus was increased from 19 to 22. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 29 November 2004 –
